title: FAQs about >x< surveys
description: Learn about >x< surveys, how they work, why you're seeing them, and how the data is used to understand >x<'s products and services.

toc.title: Why am I seeing this survey?
Why are these surveys being conducted?

runs: >x< surveys are not the same brand surveys. Learn more about
>x< surveys allow people on >x< to optionally share their perceptions of >x< and our product offerings. These surveys are currently distributed as injections in the home timeline only.
Why am I seeing this survey?
If you see an injection in your home timeline, you have been selected to participate in a survey. If you do not want to participate in the survey, simply don’t respond to any of the survey questions.
Only >x<’s internal research team tabulates and analyzes the survey results. These results reflect the combined responses of those who participated in the survey.
No. Your choice to respond or not to the survey will not alter your overall >x< experience.
Why are these surveys being conducted?

These surveys are intended to help >x< understand the effect of its products, policies, and actions, broadly, as well as how they are perceived. This is a standard industry practice across many digital platforms.
